name: financial-plan
description: Financial Plan — a personal budget planner, successor to a Numbers spreadsheet kept since 2011: a monthly grid that projects itself forward, savings goals, net worth, retirement drawdown with your own tax tables, investments and giving. This repo holds code only, never data. Single-file web app, works offline, optional Google sync.

paragraphs: Charlie's personal financial planner — the web-app successor to a Numbers spreadsheet kept since 2011. A monthly budget that projects itself forward, with the tabs that hang off it: savings goals, retirement, tax, investments, giving, trips and the household the plan is for.
No account. No install. Nothing uploaded. Your figures live in your own browser and stay there unless you deliberately sign in or send a link.

Sign-in goes through Google Identity Services — a popup straight to accounts.google.com, exchanged for a Firebase session — rather than signInWithPopup, which opens at .firebaseapp.com and dies on the corporate networks that block those hostnames one at a time.
